fields.description: Received on the Purchase Inward row. Approved Qty + Rejected Qty must equal Received Qty (BRD 4.6.2.1). Sample Qty is carved OUT OF the approved quantity and moved to the QC Sample warehouse by a separate stock movement - it is NOT a third bucket, because the GRN (Purchase Receipt) has only two: qty (accepted) and rejected_qty.
fields.label: Received Qty

fields.description: Rolled up from the Sample Testing rows whose QC Item Row key is this row. Carved OUT OF Approved Qty, not a third bucket - it leaves the accepted warehouse via its own stock movement.
fields.label: Sample Qty

fields.description: Rolled up from the Control Sample rows whose QC Item Row key is this row. Like the test sample it comes out of Approved Qty, never a separate bucket.
fields.label: Control Sample Qty

fields.description: Becomes Purchase Receipt Item.qty (Accepted Quantity). Approved + Rejected must equal Received.
fields.label: Approved Qty

fields.description: Becomes Purchase Receipt Item.rejected_qty. Approved + Rejected must equal Received.
fields.label: Rejected Qty

fields.description: Mandatory when Rejected Qty is greater than zero (BRD 4.6.2.1); also enforced server-side.
fields.label: Rejection Reason

fields.description: Derived from the approved / rejected split (BRD 4.6.2); never typed by the user.
fields.label: QC Result
fields.options:
Pending
Approved
Partially Approved
Rejected
Excess Qty Approved

fields.description: Invoice No + Inward Date for RM/PM (BR-QC-11), Batch No + Manufacturing Date for FG (BR-QC-12).
fields.label: Internal Batch No.

fields.description: Where the approved quantity lands on the GRN; defaults from the Purchase Inward row.
fields.label: Target Warehouse

fields.description: Row-level quarantine flag (BR-QC-10). Flag only in this phase - no hold, quarantine view or release is built.
fields.label: Quarantine

fields.description: Purchase Order Item row name, mirroring Purchase Receipt Item.purchase_order_item.
fields.label: PO Item Row

fields.description: Source Purchase Inward Item row name - the only safe join, since a Purchase Inward can hold two rows of the same item.
fields.label: Purchase Inward Item Row
